pages.text: The Acid Synthesizer makes $(l)Acid$() from $(l)Sulfur$() and $(l)water$(). The $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) needs Acid to dissolve the mob in its chamber, and the $(l:materials/circuits)Fabricator$(/l) etches the Advanced and Elite Circuits with it. This page also covers where to find Sulfur and how to carry Acid in a bucket.

$(li)It takes $(l)5$() $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l): one on each side of it and three on top.$(br)$(li)The finished machine is 3 blocks wide and 2 tall, with the Acid Synthesizer at the bottom of the middle.$(br)$(li)$(l)Right-click$() it while it is alone and drones show where the frames go.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: $(li)Once complete, the frames hide and the tanks and the tower rise out of its base.$(br)$(li)It doesn't work until then. Breaking a frame folds it back.

$(li)Pipe water in with a $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l): from a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l), or from a $(l:cables/fluid_tanks)Liquid Tank$(/l) filled with water buckets.$(br)$(li)Put Sulfur in its slot, by hand or with a hopper.$(br)$(li)It pushes the Acid into adjacent pipes and tanks by itself. Pipe it to an $(l)Acid Inlet$() of the Methane Extractor's chamber.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)Pipes connect to the machine block: in front, behind or below.$(br)$(li)Right-click it with an empty bucket for an $(l)Acid Bucket$() once it holds 1,000 mB.$(br)$(li)It takes Speed, Efficiency and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI.

$(li)The gauges on its two tanks show how full they are: water on the left, acid on the right.$(br)$(li)While it works, the collar turns round its tower, bubbles rise through the acid and white puffs leave the chimney.

$(li)$(l)One batch$(): 1 Sulfur + 500 mB Water → 500 mB Acid$(br)$(li)$(l)Time per batch$(): 2 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)Power$(): 40 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Water tank$(): 8,000 mB$(br)$(li)$(l)Acid tank$(): 8,000 mB$(br)A Methane Extractor uses 1 mB of Acid per tick, so one batch lasts it 25 seconds.
pages.title: Numbers
Sulfur
pages.text: $(item)Nether Sulfur Ore$() is found in netherrack all over the Nether. Mine it with a pickaxe: it drops $(l)2-4 Sulfur$(), more with Fortune. Silk Touch gives the ore block.
Sulfur is tagged forge:dusts/sulfur and the ore forge:ores/sulfur. Sulfur from other mods works in the Acid Synthesizer, and other mods' crushers and processors work on this ore.

An $(item)Acid Bucket$() holds 1,000 mB of Acid. Fill it by right-clicking the Acid Synthesizer with an empty bucket. Pour it into an Acid Inlet or any tank by right-clicking it. Acid cannot be poured into the world.
